businesses.business: distilled spirits and specialty wheat proteins and starches

offering_description.value: Produces and sells distilled spirits (bourbon, whiskey, gin, and other brown and white spirits), including branded products and bulk aged whiskey and grain neutral spirits. Also makes specialty wheat proteins and starches for food manufacturers. Products are made at its own distilleries and plants and sold to spirits brand owners, distributors, and food companies.

primary_products.value: bourbon and whiskey; grain neutral spirits and gin; branded spirits; specialty wheat proteins; specialty wheat starches

primary_services.value: contract aging and warehousing of spirits; private-label bottling and blending

customer_segment.value: B2B: spirits brand owners and marketers, beverage alcohol distributors, packaged food and pet food manufacturers; B2C: consumers buying branded premium spirits through retailers

end_markets.value: beverage alcohol; packaged foods; bakery; pet food; industrial alcohol

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded spirits, bulk whiskey and neutral spirits, wheat proteins and starches; service fees: contract warehousing, aging and bottling services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: distills spirits and processes wheat and grain into proteins and starches, sold to brand owners and food makers; brand owner: owns and markets premium branded whiskey and other spirits sold through distributors

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with exports to international markets for spirits and ingredients

specialization.value: related lines: distilled spirits (branded and bulk) and grain-based ingredient products from shared grain processing

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: alcohol beverage distributors selling branded spirits to retailers; direct sales: bulk spirits and ingredients sold directly to brand owners and food manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: alcohol production requires TTB permits and state licensing, food ingredient rules from FDA and USDA apply

notes: Company has been reshaping its portfolio, so the exact current mix may differ.
